## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the commands/checks run and their results. Relevant checks include:

- `npm run check` and `npm test` from the repository root.
- An actual OpenCode load/status check for entrypoint or hook changes.

## Compatibility and configuration

Describe any changed options, migration steps or documented behavior. Write “None” if there are no changes.

- [ ] README.md, docs/ and `policy.example.json` are updated where behavior changed.
- [ ] The change contains no live configuration, credentials, private keys or sensitive diagnostic data.
